已掌握所需全部数据。下面给出完整回答。

---

## 1. Intelligent Cloud 分部本季度收入同比增长百分比

**计算过程：**

| 项目 | FY26 Q4（截至 2026/6/30） | FY25 Q4（截至 2025/6/30） |
|---|---|---|
| Intelligent Cloud 收入 | $39,306 百万 | $29,878 百万 |

同比增长率 = ($39,306 − $29,878) / $29,878 = $9,428 / $29,878 ≈ **31.55%，四舍五入为 32%**（按固定汇率口径为 31%）。

**出处：** `press_release.txt` 第 18895 字符处的分部利润表（Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 vs 2025）；`press_release.txt` 第 3115 字符处的正文表述 "Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"。

---

## 2. 管理层在财报电话会上把增长归因于哪些因素

以下为 `transcript.txt` 第 24700–25100 字符区间内，管理层对 Intelligent Cloud 分部增长的原话引用（Satya Nadella 发言）：

> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized.** Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"

> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by **renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.**"

**归因汇总：**
- **Azure 端：**
  1. 客户持续超过可用容量（demand exceeds capacity）
  2. CPU/GPU 集群的效率提升（efficiency gains across CPU and GPU fleet）
  3. 流程改进使新容量更早交付（process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity）
  4. 季度内新增容量被快速变现（additional in-quarter capacity was quickly monetized）
  5. 6 月商业模式调整后，GitHub Copilot 消费超预期（stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following June business model change to usage-based pricing）
- **本地服务器端：**
  6. 续约合同中更高比例的当期收入确认（higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts）

---

## 3. 哪些是已发生的事实 vs 前瞻性表述

| # | 归因 | 性质 | 区分依据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 客户持续超过可用容量 | **已发生事实** | 原文用现在时 "Customer demand **continues** to exceed available capacity"，是对本季度运营状态的陈述。 |
| 2 | CPU/GPU 集群效率提升 | **已发生事实** | 原文用过去时态 "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations **driven by** efficiency gains"，"was driven by" 表示对已实现增长的归因。 |
| 3 | 流程改进使新容量更早交付 | **已发生事实** | 同上，"was ahead of expectations driven by … process improvements"，是对本季度业绩的解释。 |
| 4 | 季度内新增容量被快速变现 | **已发生事实** | "That additional in-quarter capacity … **was** quickly monetized" — 过去时，描述已完成的变现。 |
| 5 | GitHub Copilot 消费超预期（6 月商业模式调整后） | **已发生事实** | "Results **also benefited from** stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change" — 过去时 "benefited from"，描述已实现的业绩贡献；6 月的调整是已落地事件。 |
| 6 | 本地服务器续约合同中当期收入确认比例较高 | **已发生事实** | "Results were ahead of expectations **primarily driven by** renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition" — 过去时，对本季度结果的归因。 |
| — | Azure 需求"continue to exceed supply"、H1 增长加速预期 | **前瞻性表述** | 原文中管理层在展望部分提到 "we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply" 以及 "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate"——这些是对未来季度的预期，使用 "remain focused"、"expect"、"continue to expect" 等前瞻性措辞。 |
| — | FY27 全年指引中 Azure 增速约 45% | **前瞻性表述** | 原文 "In Azure, we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency" — 明确的未来指引。 |

**总结：** 上述 6 条对 Q4 实际增长的归因**全部为已发生的事实**，均使用过去时态（was driven by、benefited from、was quickly monetized），是对已披露季度业绩的解释。管理层在同一份文件中确实包含前瞻性表述（对 FY27 Q1 及全年 Azure/Intelligent Cloud 增长的展望），但那些属于指引而非对本季度增长的归因，因此未列入本问题第 2 部分的引用中。
